headline: Alabama Senate passes bills requiring device filters, app store age checks for minors
snippet: Devices after June 2025 must auto-enable filters for minors.

headline: Bills to protect minors online pass in the Senate
snippet: SB186 passes Senate requiring content filters on devices for minors.

headline: Ivey signs Cell Phone Filter Act
snippet: Gov. Ivey signs SB186, manufacturers face fines up to $5K/violation.
